briefing: Neptune is deep blue and very far from the sun.
It is the windiest place in the solar system, and its winds blow faster than a jet plane.
Dark storms come and go on Neptune, and its biggest moon, Triton, orbits backward.
Sunlight takes about four hours to reach Neptune.
Out here, the sun is just a bright star.
preflightLine: Wind won't touch us in space. The rocks will. Steady hands.
warpSentence: Neptune is deep blue and very far from the sun.
beaconFlavor: The sun is a star from here. It's still the sun.
